title: CloudConnection
description: A cloud provider connection configuration for authenticating and authorizing Cisco Cloud Observability with a cloud provider.

id.description: The unique identifier of the cloud connection.

displayName.description: A human-readable display name for the connection.

description.description: An optional description of the cloud connection.

state.description: The current state of the connection.

details.description: Provider-specific connection details including credentials and role configuration.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the connection was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the connection was last updated.
